text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Phew... That chicken was tougher than I thought it'd be!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ……
思ったより手強いニワトリでしたね☆

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: It's not a chicken. And more importantly!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ニワトリじゃないわよ……
ってそんなことより！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
You and your superhuman strength! These precious tail feathers are all tattered now!
We never should've come here...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたの馬鹿力のせいで、
せっかくの尾羽根がボロボロじゃないの！
こんなことになるなら来るんじゃなかった……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Argh! Not only did we schlep all this way for no reason, but now it's suddenly gotten chilly!
Gah! It's freezing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～
無駄足だと思ったら急に寒くなってきたぁ～
寒い寒いっ！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Chowing down on some chicken hot pot in a cold place is pretty tasty, you know!
text_block_list.orig_text:
寒い場所で食べる鶏鍋も
結構乙なもんですよ～☆

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
I said, it's not a chicken!
I'm not eating any of that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だからニワトリじゃないってば！
あたしは食べないわよ～！
